sections.title: Read and listen
sections.heading: Biscuit's secret
paragraphs: Biscuit is Sam's dog. He's small and brown, and he comes to the café every day.
Sam has one rule: no cookies for Biscuit.
“Cookies are bad for dogs,” he says.
But every morning at 10:30, the fresh cookies come out of the kitchen.
Biscuit sits under a table near the door, and he waits.
He doesn't bark. He looks at the customers with his big brown eyes.
Lucas gives him a little piece. Rose gives him a little piece.
Even Maya, the teacher, gives him a piece.
And Sam? At closing time, the café is empty.
Sam sits down with a cup of tea, and he gives Biscuit … one cookie.
